about: The webhook events LetzCloud sends, as its event catalogues list them: GET /api/v1/webhooks/event_types for a provider key and GET /api/v1/l3/webhooks/event_types for a customer key. The LetzCloud Trigger loads the live list from your account; tools/generate-docs.mjs renders this snapshot in docs/trigger.md. Update it when LetzCloud adds, renames or removes an event. The descriptions here are plain text written for these pages; the live list in the node shows LetzCloud's own descriptions.

provider.description: An instance was created. Not sent for instances that already existed when LetzCloud first read your account.
An instance changed state, or one of the details LetzCloud shows for it changed.

customer.description: An instance was created. Not sent for instances that already existed when LetzCloud first read your account.
An instance changed state, or one of the details LetzCloud shows for it changed.
A usage alert of the customer fired. Sent only for an alert whose notification channels include webhooks.
An invoice of the customer was issued (finalized) in LetzBill.
A payment attempt on an invoice of the customer was refused.
